_note: My expected outcome per case before running the tool, from reading the rules, the case metadata and every document by hand. `action` is what I would file; `also_acceptable` lists defensible alternatives on genuinely ambiguous cases; `tier` is the minimum attention level I expect the tool to flag (needs_review > medium > high).
